tasks_completed.description: Strengthened ToolDescriptionSection guard in ToolFullView.tsx to hide the Description section when tool.description is empty or echoes tool.input.command (the raw /bin/bash -lc string from Codex exec_command)
tasks_completed.changes: Replaced single-line falsy guard `if (!tool.description) return null;` with a 4-line comment + strict-equality-after-trim guard against tool.input.command. Render path unchanged — real descriptions render with original whitespace. Satisfies spec §5.7 R1-R3 + AC1-AC4.
tasks_completed.rationale: BA root-cause analysis identified tool.description for Codex exec_command is populated from c.input.description which equals the raw bash command. Render-layer guard is the smallest possible fix and is explicitly mandated by BA Contract B (typesRaw.ts and reducer.ts listed as excluded).

git_rationale.root_cause_commit: N/A (architectural gap present since Codex support introduced; ToolFullView.tsx first introduced in commit 5575d726 2026-01-25 without a command-vs-description guard)
git_rationale.why_issue_occurred: ToolDescriptionSection was written assuming tool.description is always a human-readable summary (true for Claude Code, where it comes from envelope.ev.description). The ACP/Codex path (typesRaw.ts:1035 sets description: null; reducer.ts:788,823,1030 assign c.description which for Codex derives from input.description = raw command) violates that assumption.
git_rationale.how_fix_addresses_root: Adds a render-layer check that treats tool.description as absent whenever it is empty or character-for-character equal to tool.input.command (trimmed). Real descriptions (Claude Code envelope.ev.description, Codex future model-provided summaries) are never equal to the command string, so they render unchanged.

dev.qa_notes: Verify in live Codex session (dev.life-ai.app, dev daemon, active Codex conversation with an exec_command tool call): (AC1) open right-side detail panel for a Codex Terminal tool call — Description section header + content must NOT render; Input Parameters section must render full JSON including `command` and `description` fields. (AC2) open a Claude Code Bash tool call — Description section must render as today (real summary). (AC3 not applicable — Should-have R4 fallback 'Running bash' NOT implemented; hide is the chosen path). (AC4) repeat AC1 and AC2 at both 1280x720 desktop and 390x844 mobile. QA-BA pass-with-objection concern (reducer.ts:1030 permissionMessage path): render-layer guard catches it equally — any branch that assigns c.description to tool.description is covered by the comparison at render time.

self_verification.smoke_check: skipped (no executable acceptance criteria — requires live Codex session in browser for AC1-AC4)
self_verification.notes: yarn typecheck in packages/happy-app: zero new errors attributable to ToolFullView.tsx. 4 pre-existing errors in unrelated files (SessionActionsNativeMenu.android.tsx, SidebarNavigator.tsx, SidebarAgentConversation.tsx, SidebarFileView.tsx) carried over from Cycle 2 and are NOT caused by this change (verified by reading Section 2 Cycle 2 of overnight spec). git diff --stat: 1 file changed, +8 / -1.

dev.implementation_notes: Chose MUST-have R1 (hide) over SHOULD-have R4 (synthesize 'Running bash') because R4 requires new i18n key `tools.fullView.runningBash` in 10 language files (en/ca/es/it/ja/pl/pt/ru/zh-Hans/zh-Hant), which would triple the diff for a nice-to-have fallback. The detail-panel header already identifies the tool (CodexBash -> 'Terminal'), so hiding loses no information. R1 alone fully satisfies §5.7 acceptance points 2-3 ('hide Description section OR show short summary') and BA AC1. R6 (Could-have: strip input.description from the JSON display in Input Parameters) not implemented — spec §5.7 explicitly states raw command belongs in Input Parameters; changing it would conflict with acceptance point 3. Trimmed `desc` used ONLY for guard comparison; rendering preserves original whitespace (R2).

recommendations: If R4 fallback is ever desired, add i18n key `tools.fullView.runningBash` -> 'Running bash' in all 10 language files and extend ToolDescriptionSection to return a synthesized Text node for known bash tool names ('CodexBash', 'Bash', 'execute', 'shell') instead of null. Scope expansion — out of this fix.

Consider BA follow-up spec to fix the root-cause data layer: typesRaw.ts:801-802 could map Codex input.description to null when it equals input.command, so tool.description would arrive already-nulled at the reducer. That would remove the need for the render-layer guard. Out of scope for §5.7 (BA Contract B excluded list).
QA should also verify the dev-mode Raw JSON section (ToolRawJsonSection at line 90-107) still shows tool.description — this is by design (dev mode shows all fields unconditionally).
